title: Scaling a finite expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $c\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of the pointwise scalar multiple $cf$ under $\pi$ equals $c$ times the expectation of $f$ under $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
